pocketfft, C++ header-only version, vendored unchanged from https://github.com/mreineck/pocketfft (branch `cpp`,
commit c90e55b3d529f8efa40ed01a20de22405f45fc65). License: BSD 3-Clause, see LICENSE.md. Used for the STFT of the
log-mel front end and the inverse STFT of the decoder (sizes 1024 and 960), compiled with POCKETFFT_NO_MULTITHREADING.
